sourceChanges.citationTitle: IE University integrates OpenAI tools throughout its academic ecosystem
IE University Integrity Policy for Admissions
IE University Manifesto on Artificial Intelligence

claimChanges.claimText: ChatGPT Edu is listed for IE University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.
IE University's admissions integrity policy does not allow live-stream translation services or other AI to provide language fluency during admissions interviews and assessments.

IE University's admissions integrity policy welcomes AI such as ChatGPT in the admissions process when candidates clearly identify AI-generated content, use quotation marks, and include sources and details.
A 2025-26 IE Humanities syllabus states that, for that course, ChatGPT or any other AI platform or tool is strictly prohibited for generating ideas or content, except spelling or grammar checking.

IE University's institutional AI statement frames generative AI as an opportunity to enhance pedagogy and says faculty are already using AI tools in Bachelor, Master, and Executive Education programs to improve knowledge delivery.

This crawl found official IE University AI-related sources for admissions, institutional AI positioning, and one course-level syllabus, but did not locate a public central enrolled-student generative-AI policy page in official-domain searches.
